pages.text: Welcome to the $(#FF69B4)Medical Center$()! This mod ships a rather hardcore physiological simulation: diseases, menstruation, pregnancy and STDs included.$(br2)Medical items share one usage: hold the item and $(thing)right-click your target$() (yourself works too). Wrong targets get a polite refusal~

$(item)Scalpel$() — the core tool of surgery. Combined with the various $(#FF69B4)surgery enchantments$() (hysterectomy, mastectomy, beheading, etc.) you can perform all kinds of "procedures" on a target.$(br2)Think twice before cutting — some operations are irreversible, meow!
$(item)Cotton Swab$() — used for medical sampling. Collect secretions from a target to inspect color and odor as a health indicator.$(br2)$(#FF69B4)Regular check-ups catch problems early!$()
